```{r, include=FALSE}

df <- read_csv("census_21_metro.csv")

df_g6 <- df %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      Citizen == 2 & LOC_ST_RES == 3 ~ "Immigrant — studied outside Canada",
      (Citizen == 2 & LOC_ST_RES == 1) | (Citizen == 2 & LOC_ST_RES == 2) ~ "Immigrant — studied in Canada",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(group),
    between(AGEGRP, 9, 10),        # 25–64
    between(HDGREE, 5, 13),        # postsecondary
    CIP2021_STEM_SUM < 88
    )



# Ensure the field code is integer and bring labels
df1 <- df_g6 %>%
  left_join(cip_stem_sum_lookup, by = c("CIP2021_STEM_SUM" = "cip2021_stem_sum"))

# Count immigrants by field (all study locations pooled) to pick the top 5 fields of study in immigrants
top5_fields <- df1 %>%
  group_by(CIP2021_STEM_SUM, cip_stem_sum_label) %>%
  summarise(total = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(total, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)



rates <- df1 %>%
  filter(CIP2021_STEM_SUM %in% top5_fields$CIP2021_STEM_SUM) %>%
  group_by(group, cip_stem_sum_label) %>%
  summarise(
    denom = n(),
    num   = sum(LFACT <= 2 | between(LFACT, 6, 8), na.rm = TRUE),
    emp_rate = num / pmax(denom, 1e-9),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cip_union <- rates %>%
  group_by(cip_stem_sum_label) %>%
  summarise(max_share = max(emp_rate), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(max_share) %>%
  pull(cip_stem_sum_label)

imm_rates <- rates |>
  mutate(
    cip_show   = str_wrap(cip_stem_sum_label, 36),
    cip_show   = factor(cip_show, levels = str_wrap(cip_union, 36))
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=38, fig.height=20, echo = FALSE}
ggplot(imm_rates, aes(x = cip_show, y = emp_rate, fill = group)) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = percent(emp_rate, accuracy = 0.1)),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), vjust = -0.25, size = 10) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, y = "Employment rate (25–34, postsecondary immigrants)",
    title = "Does holding postsecondary credential earned outside Canada affect the employment rate of young adult immigrants (age 25–34)?",
    subtitle = "Fields of study among young adult immigrants (CIP2021 STEM/BHASE summary)",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 30), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 25),  # bigger x tick labels (your categories)
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 30),  # bigger y tick labels
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 30),  # bigger y-axis title (optional)
    plot.title    = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold", lineheight = 1.1,
                                 margin = margin(b = 6)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 40, lineheight = 1.1,
                                 margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.caption  = element_text(size = 40)
  )+ 
  
  scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, width = 20))

```
